Thank you all. Let me synthesize the consolidated action plan with owners and deadlines so we can track readiness for execution.

1. Conflicts (Sofia): Prepare and route the founder's informed written consent request today; draft ethical screen documentation in parallel. Confirm clearance to me once both are executed and filed. 3. Circulate the updated business instructions to the drafting team. Deadline: End of day today.

4. Finance (Thomas): Enter the benchmark into the transaction summary and circulate revised royalty terms — 4.5% of net sales and a $300,000 annual minimum royalty — to the drafting team. Deadline: Today.

All four issues must be fully resolved — with documentation in hand — before we can responsibly proceed with execution next week. I will hold a readiness check once each owner confirms completion. If any issue remains open, we will delay execution until it is closed. Please confirm receipt and begin work immediately.
